mapper.select: select ADD_ID as addId, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '1',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as addAmount, sum(IF(DICT_TYPE = '2',REAL_AMOUNT,0)) as minusAmount from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and ADD_ID = #{addId} group by ADD_ID

select a.*, c.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,c.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,c.USER_NAME as userName,c.COMPANY as company, c.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,c.ORG_NAME as orgName from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD a left join HR_SALARY_ADD b on a.ADD_ID = b.ID left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD c on b.STANDARD_ID = c.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, c.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,c.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,c.USER_NAME as userName,c.COMPANY as company, c.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,c.ORG_NAME as orgName from HR_SALARY_ADD_RECORD a left join HR_SALARY_ADD b on a.ADD_ID = b.ID left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD c on b.STANDARD_ID = c.ID where a.ID = #{id}
